note: 2.0.144: multi-clip mixer output control + ratio-aware shanjian template cards. 成片设置 now offers 成片比例 (竖屏 9:16 default / 横屏 16:9) and 画面填充 (铺满裁切 default / 模糊铺底 / 完整黑边): the ratio decides the base merge canvas (9:16 -> 720x1280, 16:9 -> 1280x720, empty keeps following the first clip) and is sent to the shanjian template list so the picker only shows templates of that ratio - realMan and virtualman have 10 16:9 templates each, newsMixCutting has none and now says so instead of showing an empty grid. Fill modes: cover = scale-to-cover + crop, blur = the same frame blurred behind a fitted foreground, fit = the old letterbox. Template cards are now drawn in each template's own ratio (9:16 tall, 16:9 wide, 1:1 square, 3/4 fallback) instead of one portrait box. Also keeps 2.0.143: scene + 色系/风格 name tags, the dropped 支持正文 filter, contacts bulk-send batching (100 per request) and the WhatsApp dependency false-alarm fix.
